Position-independent amino-acid composition

Source: R/pepchem.R
aa_composition.Rd

Residue counts and frequencies over a set of sequences, optionally split by a grouping vector (Condition, Sample, ...). Non-standard residues are dropped, so the frequencies of the 20 standard residues sum to 1 within each group.

Usage

aa_composition(sequences, groups = NULL, normalize = TRUE)

Arguments

sequences

Character vector of peptide sequences.

groups

Optional grouping vector, the same length as sequences (factor levels are preserved). NULL (default) puts everything in one group called "all".

normalize

Add the within-group Frequency column. Default TRUE.

Value

A long data frame with Group, AA (a factor over the 20 standard residues, in the canonical order), Count, n_Sequences and — when normalize is TRUE — Frequency.

Examples

aa_composition(c("SIINFEKL", "GILGFVFTL"), groups = c("A", "B"))
#>    Group AA Count n_Sequences Frequency
#> 1      A  A     0           1 0.0000000
#> 2      A  R     0           1 0.0000000
